newsitem.title: BULGARIA: NO DEALS ON BULGARIA'S SOFIA STOCK EXCHANGE.
newsitem.headline: NO DEALS ON BULGARIA'S SOFIA STOCK EXCHANGE.

text.p: No corporate stocks traded on the Sofia Stock Exchange (SSE) for a nineteenth day in a row and the RABSI (Reuter All Bulgaria Stock Index) was unchanged from Wednesday's 41.31 points, brokers said.
No repo deals in treasury paper were struck on the SSE today either, said brokers.
Wednesday's repo deals turnover was 1.250 million levs.
The other local bourse, the Bulgarian Stock Exchange (BSE) has been in a summer recess since August 5 and will resume trading on September 2. -- Dessislava Popova, Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 981 8569
